contract.summary: Trello-style card board: a board of ordered lists (columns) holding ordered cards. The frozen contract (src/board/contract.js) fixes the snapshot shape, shared helpers, and the exact signatures of the two modules the tasks build: createBoard in src/lib/board.js and renderBoard in src/components/board/render.js. The renderer only consumes a plain BoardSnapshot, so model and view are built in parallel.

files.purpose: Shared types, constants, and the module API every task implements or imports
files.contents:
/**
 * Shared contract for the Trello-style board. Plain data only.
 *
 * @typedef {Object} Card
 * @property {number} id        unique across the board
 * @property {string} title
 * @property {string[]} labels  free-form tags, e.g. ['bug']
 * @property {string} listId    id of the list currently holding the card
 *
 * @typedef {Object} List
 * @property {string} id        slugify(title), e.g. 'in-progress'
 * @property {string} title
 * @property {Card[]} cards     in display order, top to bottom
 *
 * @typedef {Object} BoardSnapshot
 * @property {List[]} lists     in display order, left to right
 */

/**
 * Module API (implemented by tasks, not here).
 *
 * src/lib/board.js exports createBoard(options?: { lists?: string[] }) returning:
 *   snapshot(): BoardSnapshot                       deep copy
 *   addList(title: string): List                    appended on the right
 *   addCard(listId, title, { labels }?): Card|null  appended at the bottom; null for unknown list
 *   moveCard(cardId, toListId, toIndex?): Card|null appends when toIndex omitted, clamps otherwise;
 *                                                   null for unknown card or list
 *   removeCard(cardId): boolean
 * options.lists defaults to DEFAULT_LISTS.
 *
 * src/components/board/render.js exports renderBoard(board: BoardSnapshot, { columnWidth = 24 }?): string
 *   Side-by-side text columns, one per list. Header 'Title (count)'. Each card shows '#<id> <title>'
 *   and its labels as '[label]'. An empty list shows '(empty)'. Text longer than columnWidth is
 *   truncated with '...'.
 */

/** Lists a new board starts with when none are given. */
const DEFAULT_LISTS = Object.freeze(['To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done'])

/** Turns a list title into its id: lowercase, non-alphanumerics collapsed to '-'. */
function slugify(title) {
  return String(title).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
}

module.exports = { DEFAULT_LISTS, slugify }

files.purpose: Frozen shared contract: column constants, Board/Card shape, and the store + renderer API both tasks build against
files.contents:
/**
 * Shared contract for the Trello-style board. Frozen: do not edit inside a task.
 *
 * @typedef {'todo' | 'doing' | 'done'} ColumnId
 *
 * @typedef {Object} Card
 * @property {number} id
 * @property {string} title
 * @property {ColumnId} column
 *
 * @typedef {Object} Column
 * @property {ColumnId} id
 * @property {string} title   Display title, from COLUMN_TITLES
 * @property {Card[]} cards   In insertion/move order; a moved card goes to the end
 *
 * @typedef {Object} Board
 * @property {Column[]} columns  Always all of COLUMNS, in COLUMNS order, even when empty
 *
 * Store API (task board-store, src/lib/board.js):
 *   module.exports = { createBoard }
 *   createBoard() -> independent board; card ids start at 1 per board.
 *     addCard(title, column = 'todo') -> Card. Throws on unknown column or empty/blank title.
 *     moveCard(id, to) -> Card | null. null for unknown id; throws on unknown column; appends to target.
 *     removeCard(id) -> boolean.
 *     snapshot() -> Board, deep copy; mutating it never changes the board.
 *
 * Renderer API (task board-render, src/components/board/render.js):
 *   module.exports = { renderBoard }
 *   renderBoard(board: Board) -> string. One block per column in board.columns order,
 *   blocks joined by one blank line, no trailing newline:
 *     == To Do (2) ==
 *     - #1 first card
 *     - #3 another
 *   An empty column renders its header followed by the line "  (empty)".
 */

/** Column ids in display order. */
const COLUMNS = Object.freeze(['todo', 'doing', 'done'])

/** Display title per column id. */
const COLUMN_TITLES = Object.freeze({ todo: 'To Do', doing: 'Doing', done: 'Done' })

function isColumn(value) {
  return COLUMNS.includes(value)
}

module.exports = { COLUMNS, COLUMN_TITLES, isColumn }
